notes.title: No Way (an) Up(date?!)
notes.content:
This week is my birthday, and I want to celebrate with all of you by giving you 50% off the game and masses of improvements. Including (but not limited to):

[list]
[*] Revised levels - Almost half of the existing levels have had the difficulty hiked up and many puzzles made much more interesting.
[*] Sound - I've devised an entirely new audio system to keep everything consistent.
[*] Equalisation - Volume levels have been severely stomped down and normalised.
[*] Background music - As requested, more dark, sinister ambience...
[*] Lighting - The 'black wall' issue should be resolved.
[*] Dialogue - The story has been almost entirely rewritten to be less wacky.
[*] Menu Navigation - Page left/right buttons added to the main menu.
[*] Optimisation - Lots of minor fixes and quality of life improvements.
[*] 2 new achievements!
[*] Dancing... Just to take the edge off.
[/list]Minor update - v1.0.2:
[list]
[*] Dialogue Skip - Story dialogue is now always [i]on[/i] by default when replaying levels, [b]but[/b] it can also be toggled on/off in the Options menu.
[/list]
Thank you all so much for all the feedback since release. Every single word has been taken on board, and I think this update has it all covered - plus much more! Now the game is all nice and polished, time to start work on Part 2...

Thanks for playing!
Don't forget to follow JellieBox at: https://www.facebook.com/JellieBoxGames
